title: BattINFO Test Protocol
description: Canonical BattINFO reusable test protocol metadata. The descriptive layer is an ordered, typed `method` of steps (queryable, not executed); the actionable layer is `artifacts`, links to runnable protocol files. Humans author the method as PyBaMM-style strings which are parsed into `method` on ingest.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.

identifier.description: Local identifier for the protocol (e.g. a lab protocol code).

kind.description: Kind of test the protocol implements.

test_spec.description: Identity and classification of the protocol.

method.description: Ordered, typed descriptive steps. Canonical structured form of the procedure.

time_s.description: Record a data point every this many seconds.

voltage_V.description: Record a data point on a voltage change of this many volts.

current_mA.description: Record a data point on a current change of this many milliamps.

safety.description: Global instrument hard limits, distinct from per-step termination.

max_voltage_V.description: Hard upper voltage limit in volts; the instrument aborts beyond it.

min_voltage_V.description: Hard lower voltage limit in volts.

max_current_mA.description: Hard upper current limit in milliamps.

min_current_mA.description: Hard lower current limit in milliamps.

delay_s.description: Grace period in seconds before the safety limits are enforced.

conditions.description: Planned protocol-level conditions, as a map of condition name to a {value, unit} quantity. Recommended keys: ambient_temperature, upper_voltage_limit, lower_voltage_limit, c_rate. As-run values or deviations are recorded on the test record.

facets.description: Derived rollup index of the method for cheap filtering. Computed from `method`; never authored by hand.

artifacts.description: Actionable-layer links to runnable protocol files.

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

source_file.description: Filename or path of the source file, when the record was derived from a file.

derived_from_artifact.description: Role or locator of the artifact this method was derived from.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

workflow_version.description: Version of the ingest/curation workflow that produced this record.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source (document title, instrument, lab, or system).

file_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source file, for integrity verification.

curated_by.description: Name or identifier of the person who curated this record.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

notes.description: Free-text notes carried with the record.

license.description: License under which this record and its data are released, as an SPDX license identifier (e.g. "cc-by-4.0") or a license URL. Stamped from the workspace default (ws.license) and emitted as dcterms:license in JSON-LD.

funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced.

contributor.description: People who contributed this record to the platform (attribution/provenance). Each is a schema:Person; an ORCID may be given in same_as. Distinct from data authorship (creators).

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

min_value.description: Lower bound of a window quantity (e.g. a 2.5-4.2 V voltage window); field names align with modules/common/quantity.schema.json.

max_value.description: Upper bound of a window quantity; field names align with modules/common/quantity.schema.json.

quantity.description: Quantity monitored for the termination condition.

direction.description: Whether the step ends when the quantity falls below or rises above the threshold, or when the duration has elapsed.

Termination.description: A condition that ends a protocol step.

mode.description: Electrochemical mode of the step (constant current, constant voltage, rest, EIS, ...).

step_id.description: Identifier assigned to this step in the test program/schedule. Corresponds to BDF step_id. Not constrained to zero-based, contiguous, monotonic, or unique values.

direction.description: Current direction or role of the step.

setpoints.description: Controlled setpoints for the step (e.g. current, c_rate, voltage, power), each a value+unit quantity.

temperature.description: Ambient temperature setpoint for the step.

period.description: Step-level data-recording cadence overriding the protocol default.

count.description: Repeat count when this step is a repeated group.

steps.description: Child steps of a repeated group.

Step.description: One typed step of the protocol, or a repeated group of child steps.

role.description: How the artifact relates to the record: the authored protocol, the executed program, a vendor export, or a simulation input.

locator.description: Where the artifact lives: a URL, DOI, or path within the linked dataset.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the file.

conforms_to.description: IRI or label of the format specification the artifact conforms to.

generated.description: Locators of artifacts generated from this one (e.g. an executed program exported from the source protocol).

generated_from.description: Locator of the artifact this one was generated from.

Artifact.description: A runnable or vendor-produced protocol/data file linked to the record.

Funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced. Maps to schema:funding / schema:Grant in JSON-LD.

id.description: Resolvable IRI of the grant (e.g. a CORDIS project IRI).

identifier.description: Grant number as assigned by the funder (e.g. '101069765').

same_as.description: External identifier IRI for the funder (e.g. a ROR or DOI funder IRI).
External identifier IRI for this organization (e.g. ROR or Wikidata).

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.

same_as.description: External identifier IRI, typically an ORCID (https://orcid.org/...).

affiliation.description: Organization the person is affiliated with.

Person.description: A person, in schema.org Person terms; an ORCID may be given in same_as.
